items.prompt:
The original text an author borrows from is the:
A) source material
B) conclusion
C) title page

Reshaping borrowed material for a new purpose is to:
A) transform it
B) copy it exactly
C) delete it

A connection between two texts is called an:
A) intertextual connection
B) index
C) epilogue

A modern novel retells an underworld-descent myth but sets it in a subway. The author:
A) draws on the myth and transforms its setting
B) invented everything with no source
C) copied the myth word for word
items.answer: A) draws on the myth and transforms its setting

solution.answer: A) draws on the myth and transforms its setting

items.prompt:
Why TRANSFORM source material instead of copying it?
A) to give familiar material new meaning for a new audience
B) to avoid originality
C) it is required by law
items.answer: A) to give familiar material new meaning for a new audience

solution.answer: A) to give familiar material new meaning for a new audience

items.prompt:
A play reworks an old tragedy but gives the villain a sympathetic motive. This is:
A) transforming the source by complicating a character
B) leaving the source unchanged
C) unrelated to the source
items.answer: A) transforming the source by complicating a character

steps: Reshapes the source. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) transforming the source by complicating a character

items.prompt:
A modern film keeps a myth's plot (a doomed couple from feuding families) but moves it to rival street gangs. This BEST shows the author:
A) drawing on a source's pattern while transforming its context
B) inventing a plot with no source
C) only summarizing the myth
items.answer: A) drawing on a source's pattern while transforming its context

steps: Pattern kept, context changed. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) drawing on a source's pattern while transforming its context

items.prompt:
To analyze how a work draws on and transforms a source, you should identify:
A) what it borrows AND how it reshapes it for a new purpose
B) only the page count
C) only the author's name
items.answer: A) what it borrows AND how it reshapes it for a new purpose

solution.answer: A) what it borrows AND how it reshapes it for a new purpose
